comment: Extremely hard grader and gives absolutely no feedback on assignments. The class goes by fast but only because you have to be 100% attentive the entire time, otherwise she will call you out. Do not recommend, it will drop your GPA and is a waste of a class. If you aren't leading the discussion she will not give you a good grade.

In a class like Sociology, it is easy to teach one's own politics. Instead of analyzing class, gender, and other marginalizing sociological forces, she instead focuses on race (black people) and how they are marginalized. Like every class, every reading. We are so behind with the concepts we're supposed to learn, but she won't stop talking.

Very tough grader and does not give feedback on final grades. Be prepared to read a lot and participate 24/7. She is a very harsh participation grader. Not many assignments: participation, podcasts, paper, portfolio. Do not recommend. Would not take again!

I entered her class with an open mind and I learned a lot! If you're taking her, I suggest you do the same. She doesn't give tests/quizzes and the class is graded based on 25% for participation, two podcasts that add up to 25%, a socio biography paper worth 25%, and a final reflection google slides presentation worth 25%. Participate and do it well

Very knowledgeable professor, not afraid to call out students problematic behaviors, we dived into race, gender, sexuality a lot and she tended to condemn any racist or sexist words or actions. The readings are very interesting, hard to get an A on an assignment - effort matters. You learn a lot, class is progressive, enjoyed it overall.

Dr. Richards was a nice enough person, but I loathed her class. She gave me the same grade on every assignment no matter how hard I worked on it and I felt like I had no chance of getting a better grade. The class discussions were interesting but you had to practically lead them to get an A. A majority of my grade was from after Thanksgiving break.
Loved Dr. Richards and the content in which we engaged in! Be ready to be uncomfortable, if you are White, because she does deal with race and racism a lot. As a black male I enjoyed this class.
This class is very discussion based and most of the projects arent assigned till the end of the semester. She is a very harsh grader and doesnt give much opportunity to bring your grade up.
Avoid her if you can. Class structure is very poor and teaching style did not make class engaging.

She is the worst teacher ever. She is not consistent in what she wants in her 1,000 page essays she assigns. Do not take her if you do not have to. She will make you cry with the grades she gives you and then turn around be the nicest to you in person. You have been warned
Absolutely terrible. Avoid at all costs. Friends of mine who were A students and worked hard consistently got C- on her papers. Hated by everyone.

Worst professor at Richmond. If you REALLY need to take sociology, wait another semester and find another professor. She is stubborn, unclear, and generally unfriendly. The average scores for tests and papers were almost always C's... for an 100 level class. Do not take.
Quite possibly the worst professor I've ever had the displeasure of interacting with. Unfair, unwilling to help students, stubborn with her ideas. Can't even spell jeopardy.

She was really nice. It was her 1st semester teaching so I was understanding. However, her instructions were unclear and her grading harsh. I got C's on all my papers. She also just blew through the content without really explaining it. I could have gotten the same experience from the textbook w/o taking the class.

Terrible teacher. Unclear and always blames the student for her mistakes. the most frustrating class i have ever taken.  a lot of work but grades are pretty random. this teacher literally gave me nightmares.
Knowing I had to come to this class everyday made me want to cry. Do not take her no matter what.
